name: 35pr-val13-adjudication-flow
description: 35 Purves Road Valuation 13 Adjudication & Statutory Debt Enforcement Flow

step.name: p01-val13-debt-validation
step.prompt: Audit Valuation 13 under RIBA DBC 2018; verify default payment notice and absence of timely Pay Less Notice.

step.name: p02-retention-release-audit
step.prompt: Audit retention release clause and establish client breach upon practical completion / repossession.

step.name: p03-riba-notice-of-adjudication
step.prompt: Draft formal Notice of Adjudication under RIBA DBC 2018 dispute resolution rules.

step.name: p04-tcc-enforcement-pack
step.prompt: Prepare High Court CPR Part 8 / Part 24 summary enforcement application for immediate recovery.
